picks.title: 不存在的罪人
picks.summary: 影片改编自柯琳·胡佛的同名畅销小说。知名作家维莉蒂因故无法完成新作，潦倒作家洛温受邀前往其偏远庄园代笔，却意外发现维莉蒂诡异的自传手稿。面对其中关于丈夫杰里米的扭曲告白，洛温逐渐难辨虚实、操控与诱惑。

picks.title: 黄金时段
picks.summary: 聚焦电视主持人克里斯·汉森与他推出的一档真人秀节目“猎捕恋童癖”，该节目利用人员在网络上伪装成未成年人，引诱恋童癖进入摄影棚，并将其逮捕。
picks.summaryEn: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history, turning an undercover investigation into one of the most controversial cultural phenomena of the decade.

picks.title: 大学炸弹客
picks.summary: 在这部改编自真人真事的剧情片中，联邦调查局一路追捕特德·卡钦斯基，而他从哈佛神童和实验对象一步步变成“大学炸弹客”的历程也随之揭晓。
picks.summaryEn: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurf

picks.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
picks.summary: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？
picks.summaryEn: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

picks.title: 副警长
picks.summary: 一名年轻的警长副手奉命监视一具尸体，结果这具尸体却从犯罪现场消失了，他因此成为了危险罪犯的眼中钉。
picks.summaryEn: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

picks.title: 为了你的母亲
picks.titleEn: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
picks.summary: 一个虔诚的杀手在杀人的工作、信仰和当父亲的责任之间挣扎，他要保护自己的孩子们，直面来袭的势力和濒临崩塌的信仰。
picks.summaryEn: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the force
